title: A8 freeze-pin re-baseline record (P3 instance) — machine-readable old->new
rule_statement: An A8 freeze pin MUST be updated inside the SAME FREEZE WINDOW as the commit that changes the pinned bytes. 'Same freeze window' REPLACES the previous 'same commit' wording: a pinned artifact's byte change and its pin update need not be in one commit, but they MUST NOT be in two different freeze windows. A freeze window is the maximal commit interval [start, end] of one authorised MUST-FIX batch, where start is the first commit of that batch that changes a pinned production artifact and end is the last commit of that batch (a trailing test-only re-baseline commit included). Both endpoints count, so a pin update that precedes or follows the byte change is compliant as long as the interval does not open or close in between.
rule_source: docs/p3/P3_RELEASE_GATE.md §2.2 (relaxed from 'the same commit that freezes the SHA'); P4 item 12.
rule_history: Prior text: 'Re-baseline ONLY in the same commit that freezes the SHA' (packages/jcc_core/tests/test_p3_acceptance_gate.py:407, owner harbor). Relaxed because the byte change and the pin update have different owners (forge vs harbor), so a single commit was not available without violating the ownership rule; the P3 net state is green.

registered_windows.compliance_note: Byte change and pin update are the same commit, so the pre-relaxation wording was satisfied.

Contains BOTH the budget.py byte change (280bfa8) and the pin update (3936c96). Under the relaxed wording this re-baseline is compliant; under the old 'same commit' wording it would have been a violation. This is the case that motivated the relaxation.
